20	  has_many :users, through: :memberships
    21	  has_many :messages, dependent: :destroy
    22	
    23	  belongs_to :creator, class_name: "User", default: -> { Current.user }
    24	
    25	  validate :direct_rooms_keep_their_type, on: :update
    26	
    27	  scope :opens,           -> { where(type: "Rooms::Open") }
    28	  scope :closeds,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Closed") }
    29	  scope :directs,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    30	  scope :without_directs, -> { where.not(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    31	
    32	  scope :ordered, -> { order("LOWER(name)") }
    33	
    34	  class << self
    35	    def create_for(attributes, users:)
    36	      transaction do
    37	        create!(attributes).tap do |room|
    38	          room.memberships.grant_to users
    39	        end
    40	      end
    41	    end
    42	
    43	    def original
    44	      order(:created_at).first
    45	    end
    46	  end
    47	
    48	  def receive(message)
    49	    unread_memberships(message)
    50	    push_later(message)
    51	  end
    52	
    53	  def open?
    54	    is_a?(Rooms::Open)
    55	  end
    56	
    57	  def closed?
    58	    is_a?(Rooms::Closed)
    59	  end
    60	
    61	  def direct?
    62	    is_a?(Rooms::Direct)
    63	  end
    64	
    65	  def default_involvement
    66	    "mentions"
    67	  end
    68	
    69	  private
    70	    # Open and closed rooms convert into each other freely. A direct room can't become
    71	    # either: its participants agreed to a private conversation, not to one whose
    72	    # audience someone else gets to widen afterwards.
    73	    def direct_rooms_keep_their_type
    74	      if type_changed? && type_was == "Rooms::Direct"
    75	        errors.add :type, "can't be changed for a direct room"
    76	      end
    77	    end
    78	
    79	    def unread_memberships(message)
    80	      memberships.visible.disconnected.where.not(user: message.creator).update_all(unread_at: message.created_at, updated_at: Time.current)
    81	    end
